name: The Army Wants You
teaserText: The women have had their chance. Perhaps the army has lower standards.
startText:
By the end of the week, Anthony's domestic difficulties had become public entertainment. His wife had left, the neighbours had developed a remarkable interest in avoiding him, and the village elders had suggested that he might do everyone a favour by finding employment elsewhere.

Anthony took this as a sign.

He would enlist as the army offered steady meals, regular wages and the opportunity to meet entirely new people who disliked him.

The recruiting officer listened to Anthony's ambitions with the expression of a man who had heard every possible lie before breakfast.

"Can you throw a javelin?"

Anthony said he could.

The officer pointed to the targets.
winText:
The javelin struck its target. The recruiting officer nodded, as though this had been the result he expected all along.

Anthony had been accepted into the army. At last, a respectable career lay before him.

It was not necessarily a career he would enjoy.
loseText: A javelin is not a walking stick, and throwing it at random is not a recognised military discipline. The officer walks away as he has other recruits to disappoint.
